# Single-file HTML canvas games

Follow these conventions when you build a browser game in one HTML file.

## Structure
- One `index.html` with inline `<style>` and one inline `<script>`; no external libraries or assets.
- A single `<canvas>` sized with CSS to fit the window while keeping its aspect ratio; draw at a fixed logical resolution (for example 800x600) and scale.
- Keep the code in this order: constants, state, input, update, draw, game loop, start.

## Game loop
- Drive the loop with `requestAnimationFrame` and a delta time in seconds, clamped to 1/30 s so a background tab does not make objects jump.
- Keep `update(dt)` and `draw()` separate; never draw inside update.
- Use a small state machine: `title`, `playing`, `levelClear`, `gameOver`, `win`.

## Input
- Keyboard: arrow keys and A/D to move, Space or Enter to start, launch and restart. Track pressed keys in a set on `keydown`/`keyup` and call `preventDefault()` for the arrow keys and Space.
- Mouse: move the paddle or player with `mousemove` using the canvas bounding rectangle; click to start or launch.
- Touch: mirror the mouse handlers with `touchstart`/`touchmove` and `{ passive: false }`.

## Gameplay details
- Store levels as arrays of strings, one character per brick or tile, so a level is easy to read and edit.
- Show score, lives and level in a HUD drawn on the canvas.
- Give the player a short pause and a message between levels and after losing a life.
- Make collisions robust: move in small steps or resolve along the axis of least penetration so fast objects do not tunnel.

## Finish
- Check that the file opens without console errors and that every state can be reached.
- Keep the file under about 600 lines.

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Brick Breaker</title>
<style>
  html, body { margin: 0; height: 100%; background: #0b0f1a; overflow: hidden; }
  body { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
  canvas {
    display: block;
    width: min(100vw, calc(100vh * 4 / 3));
    height: min(100vh, calc(100vw * 3 / 4));
    background: #111827;
    cursor: none;
    touch-action: none;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game" width="800" height="600"></canvas>
<script>
// ---------- Constants ----------
const W = 800, H = 600;
const HUD_H = 40;
const PADDLE_W = 110, PADDLE_H = 14, PADDLE_Y = H - 40, PADDLE_SPEED = 600;
const BALL_R = 7;
const BRICK_COLS = 10, BRICK_W = 72, BRICK_H = 22, BRICK_GAP = 4;
const BRICK_OFFSET_X = (W - (BRICK_COLS * BRICK_W + (BRICK_COLS - 1) * BRICK_GAP)) / 2;
const BRICK_OFFSET_Y = HUD_H + 40;
const START_LIVES = 3;
const PAUSE_TIME = 1.5;

// '.' = empty, '1' = 1 hit, '2' = 2 hits, '3' = 3 hits
const LEVELS = [
  {
    speed: 340,
    rows: [
      "1111111111",
      "1111111111",
      "2222222222",
      "1111111111",
      "1111111111",
    ],
  },
  {
    speed: 400,
    rows: [
      "3..3333..3",
      "2222222222",
      "22.2222.22",
      "1111111111",
      ".11.11.11.",
      "1111111111",
    ],
  },
];

const BRICK_COLORS = { 1: "#38bdf8", 2: "#a78bfa", 3: "#f472b6" };
const BRICK_POINTS = { 1: 10, 2: 20, 3: 30 };

// ---------- State ----------
const canvas = document.getElementById("game");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

let state = "title"; // title, playing, levelClear, gameOver, win
let score = 0;
let lives = START_LIVES;
let levelIndex = 0;
let bricks = [];
let pauseTimer = 0;
let message = "";
const paddle = { x: W / 2 - PADDLE_W / 2, y: PADDLE_Y, w: PADDLE_W, h: PADDLE_H };
const ball = { x: 0, y: 0, vx: 0, vy: 0, r: BALL_R, attached: true };

function buildLevel(i) {
  bricks = [];
  LEVELS[i].rows.forEach((row, r) => {
    for (let c = 0; c < row.length; c++) {
      const ch = row[c];
      if (ch === ".") continue;
      const hp = parseInt(ch, 10);
      bricks.push({
        x: BRICK_OFFSET_X + c * (BRICK_W + BRICK_GAP),
        y: BRICK_OFFSET_Y + r * (BRICK_H + BRICK_GAP),
        w: BRICK_W, h: BRICK_H, hp, maxHp: hp,
      });
    }
  });
}

function resetBall() {
  ball.attached = true;
  ball.vx = 0;
  ball.vy = 0;
  ball.x = paddle.x + paddle.w / 2;
  ball.y = paddle.y - ball.r - 1;
}

function startGame() {
  score = 0;
  lives = START_LIVES;
  levelIndex = 0;
  buildLevel(levelIndex);
  paddle.x = W / 2 - PADDLE_W / 2;
  resetBall();
  state = "playing";
}

function launchBall() {
  if (!ball.attached) return;
  const speed = LEVELS[levelIndex].speed;
  const angle = (-Math.PI / 2) + (Math.random() * 0.6 - 0.3);
  ball.vx = Math.cos(angle) * speed;
  ball.vy = Math.sin(angle) * speed;
  ball.attached = false;
}

// Space / Enter / click: start, launch, restart
function primaryAction() {
  if (state === "title" || state === "gameOver" || state === "win") {
    startGame();
  } else if (state === "playing" && pauseTimer <= 0) {
    launchBall();
  }
}

// ---------- Input ----------
const keys = new Set();
let mouseActive = false;

window.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  if (["ArrowLeft", "ArrowRight", "ArrowUp", "ArrowDown", " "].includes(e.key)) e.preventDefault();
  keys.add(e.key.toLowerCase());
  if (e.key === " " || e.key === "Enter") {
    if (!e.repeat) primaryAction();
  }
  if (["arrowleft", "arrowright", "a", "d"].includes(e.key.toLowerCase())) mouseActive = false;
});
window.addEventListener("keyup", (e) => keys.delete(e.key.toLowerCase()));
window.addEventListener("blur", () => keys.clear());

function pointerToCanvasX(clientX) {
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  return (clientX - rect.left) * (W / rect.width);
}

function movePaddleTo(x) {
  paddle.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(W - paddle.w, x - paddle.w / 2));
}

canvas.addEventListener("mousemove", (e) => {
  mouseActive = true;
  movePaddleTo(pointerToCanvasX(e.clientX));
});
canvas.addEventListener("mousedown", (e) => {
  e.preventDefault();
  primaryAction();
});
canvas.addEventListener("touchstart", (e) => {
  e.preventDefault();
  if (e.touches.length) movePaddleTo(pointerToCanvasX(e.touches[0].clientX));
  primaryAction();
}, { passive: false });
canvas.addEventListener("touchmove", (e) => {
  e.preventDefault();
  if (e.touches.length) movePaddleTo(pointerToCanvasX(e.touches[0].clientX));
}, { passive: false });

// ---------- Update ----------
function update(dt) {
  if (state === "levelClear") {
    pauseTimer -= dt;
    if (pauseTimer <= 0) {
      levelIndex++;
      buildLevel(levelIndex);
      paddle.x = W / 2 - PADDLE_W / 2;
      resetBall();
      state = "playing";
    }
    return;
  }
  if (state !== "playing") return;

  // Paddle (keyboard)
  let dir = 0;
  if (keys.has("arrowleft") || keys.has("a")) dir -= 1;
  if (keys.has("arrowright") || keys.has("d")) dir += 1;
  if (dir !== 0) {
    paddle.x += dir * PADDLE_SPEED * dt;
    paddle.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(W - paddle.w, paddle.x));
  }

  if (pauseTimer > 0) {
    pauseTimer -= dt;
    if (pauseTimer <= 0) message = "";
  }

  if (ball.attached) {
    ball.x = paddle.x + paddle.w / 2;
    ball.y = paddle.y - ball.r - 1;
    return;
  }

  // Move ball in small sub-steps to avoid tunnelling
  const speed = Math.hypot(ball.vx, ball.vy);
  const steps = Math.max(1, Math.ceil((speed * dt) / (ball.r * 0.5)));
  const sdt = dt / steps;
  for (let i = 0; i < steps; i++) {
    if (stepBall(sdt)) break;
  }
}

// Returns true if the step ended the ball's motion (life lost / level clear)
function stepBall(dt) {
  ball.x += ball.vx * dt;
  ball.y += ball.vy * dt;

  // Walls
  if (ball.x - ball.r < 0) { ball.x = ball.r; ball.vx = Math.abs(ball.vx); }
  if (ball.x + ball.r > W) { ball.x = W - ball.r; ball.vx = -Math.abs(ball.vx); }
  if (ball.y - ball.r < HUD_H) { ball.y = HUD_H + ball.r; ball.vy = Math.abs(ball.vy); }

  // Bottom: lose a life
  if (ball.y - ball.r > H) {
    lives--;
    if (lives <= 0) {
      state = "gameOver";
    } else {
      message = "Life lost! " + lives + (lives === 1 ? " life" : " lives") + " left";
      pauseTimer = PAUSE_TIME;
      resetBall();
    }
    return true;
  }

  // Paddle
  if (ball.vy > 0 && circleRect(ball, paddle)) {
    const hit = (ball.x - (paddle.x + paddle.w / 2)) / (paddle.w / 2); // -1..1
    const clamped = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, hit));
    const angle = clamped * (Math.PI / 3); // up to 60 degrees
    const speed = Math.hypot(ball.vx, ball.vy);
    ball.vx = Math.sin(angle) * speed;
    ball.vy = -Math.cos(angle) * speed;
    ball.y = paddle.y - ball.r - 0.1;
  }

  // Bricks: resolve along axis of least penetration
  for (let i = 0; i < bricks.length; i++) {
    const b = bricks[i];
    if (!circleRect(ball, b)) continue;

    const overlapLeft = ball.x + ball.r - b.x;
    const overlapRight = b.x + b.w - (ball.x - ball.r);
    const overlapTop = ball.y + ball.r - b.y;
    const overlapBottom = b.y + b.h - (ball.y - ball.r);
    const minX = Math.min(overlapLeft, overlapRight);
    const minY = Math.min(overlapTop, overlapBottom);
    if (minX < minY) {
      if (overlapLeft < overlapRight) { ball.x -= overlapLeft; ball.vx = -Math.abs(ball.vx); }
      else { ball.x += overlapRight; ball.vx = Math.abs(ball.vx); }
    } else {
      if (overlapTop < overlapBottom) { ball.y -= overlapTop; ball.vy = -Math.abs(ball.vy); }
      else { ball.y += overlapBottom; ball.vy = Math.abs(ball.vy); }
    }

    b.hp--;
    if (b.hp <= 0) {
      score += BRICK_POINTS[b.maxHp];
      bricks.splice(i, 1);
    } else {
      score += 5;
    }

    if (bricks.length === 0) {
      score += lives * 100;
      if (levelIndex + 1 < LEVELS.length) {
        state = "levelClear";
        pauseTimer = 2;
      } else {
        state = "win";
      }
      return true;
    }
    break; // one brick per step
  }
  return false;
}

function circleRect(c, r) {
  const nx = Math.max(r.x, Math.min(c.x, r.x + r.w));
  const ny = Math.max(r.y, Math.min(c.y, r.y + r.h));
  const dx = c.x - nx, dy = c.y - ny;
  return dx * dx + dy * dy <= c.r * c.r;
}

// ---------- Draw ----------
function draw() {
  ctx.fillStyle = "#111827";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // HUD
  ctx.fillStyle = "#1f2937";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, HUD_H);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#e5e7eb";
  ctx.font = "bold 18px system-ui, sans-serif";
  ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
  ctx.textAlign = "left";
  ctx.fillText("Score: " + score, 16, HUD_H / 2);
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.fillText("Level " + (levelIndex + 1) + " / " + LEVELS.length, W / 2, HUD_H / 2);
  ctx.textAlign = "right";
  ctx.fillText("Lives:", W - 16 - 3 * 22, HUD_H / 2);
  for (let i = 0; i < START_LIVES; i++) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(W - 16 - 8 - (START_LIVES - 1 - i) * 22, HUD_H / 2, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = i < lives ? "#f87171" : "#4b5563";
    ctx.fill();
  }

  if (state === "title") {
    drawCenter("BRICK BREAKER", "Press Space / Enter or click to start",
      "Move: Arrow keys, A/D or mouse  ·  Launch: Space or click");
    return;
  }

  // Bricks
  for (const b of bricks) {
    ctx.fillStyle = BRICK_COLORS[b.hp];
    ctx.fillRect(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h);
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.25)";
    ctx.fillRect(b.x, b.y, b.w, 4);
  }

  // Paddle
  ctx.fillStyle = "#facc15";
  roundRect(paddle.x, paddle.y, paddle.w, paddle.h, 6);

  // Ball
  if (state === "playing" || state === "levelClear") {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, ball.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
    ctx.fill();
  }

  if (state === "playing") {
    if (message) {
      drawBanner(message);
    } else if (ball.attached) {
      drawBanner("Press Space or click to launch");
    }
  } else if (state === "levelClear") {
    drawCenter("LEVEL " + (levelIndex + 1) + " CLEAR!", "Get ready for level " + (levelIndex + 2) + "...", "");
  } else if (state === "gameOver") {
    drawCenter("GAME OVER", "Final score: " + score, "Press Space / Enter or click to play again");
  } else if (state === "win") {
    drawCenter("YOU WIN!", "Final score: " + score, "Press Space / Enter or click to play again");
  }
}

function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
  ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
}

function drawBanner(text) {
  ctx.fillStyle = "#e5e7eb";
  ctx.font = "20px system-ui, sans-serif";
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.fillText(text, W / 2, H - 110);
}

function drawCenter(title, line1, line2) {
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.6)";
  ctx.fillRect(0, HUD_H, W, H - HUD_H);
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.fillStyle = "#facc15";
  ctx.font = "bold 52px system-ui, sans-serif";
  ctx.fillText(title, W / 2, H / 2 - 50);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#e5e7eb";
  ctx.font = "22px system-ui, sans-serif";
  ctx.fillText(line1, W / 2, H / 2 + 10);
  ctx.font = "16px system-ui, sans-serif";
  ctx.fillStyle = "#9ca3af";
  ctx.fillText(line2, W / 2, H / 2 + 50);
}

// ---------- Game loop ----------
let last = performance.now();
function loop(now) {
  const dt = Math.min((now - last) / 1000, 1 / 30);
  last = now;
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

// ---------- Start ----------
buildLevel(0);
resetBall();
requestAnimationFrame((t) => { last = t; loop(t); });
</script>
</body>
</html>

Where the ball hits the paddle sets its bounce angle.
